entries.04fe400681d50fcb: These are production and sales in Japan, undertaken by the company and its domestic consolidated subsidiaries. In addition to four company-owned plants, the Shizuoka Plant, Haibara Plant, Sagara Plant and Fujikawa Machinery Plant, subsidiaries including Koito Kyushu Co., Ltd. and Aoitec Co., Ltd. manufacture automotive lighting. Koito Denko Co., Ltd. handles railway vehicle control equipment, road traffic signals and traffic control systems, railway vehicle seats and so on, and the transport services of Koito Unso Co., Ltd. and the insurance agency business of Koito Insurance Service Co., Ltd. also fall into this segment. The largest customer is TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION, and its sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥128,481 million (13.6% of total sales). Revenue in this segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥367.8 billion, up 4.6% from the previous year, due to new orders and higher sales of the company's ordered vehicle models.
entries.6cdc47f06a53bfba: Koito Czech s.r.o. in the Czech Republic manufactures and sells automotive lighting for the European market. In November 2025, the company transferred all shares of Koito Europe Limited (United Kingdom) to Shapers’Group Limited and excluded it from the scope of consolidation, so it has also been removed from the table of business details and the business structure diagram. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥35.1 billion, down 2.9% from the previous year, partly reflecting the effect of the transfer of the UK subsidiary.
entries.c00c67679517e3b7: A company that makes automotive lighting such as headlamps and supplies them to automakers around the world, including [[company:toyota|TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION]].
entries.d4de039321931290: Guangzhou Koito Automotive Lamp Co., Ltd., Hubei Koito Automotive Lamp Co., Ltd. and Fuzhou Koito Automotive Lamp Co., Ltd., three companies in total, manufacture and sell automotive lighting in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥53.3 billion, down 8.5% from the previous year, owing in part to continued weak sales of Japanese-made vehicles, which account for a large share of the company's sales. In this year, the company recorded an impairment loss related to its China business.
entries.dad0a7d5a51cc037: These are production and sales in Thailand, Indonesia, Taiwan, India and Malaysia. Thai Koito Co., Ltd. (Thailand), PT. Indonesia Koito (Indonesia), Ta-Yi Transportation Industrial Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (Taiwan), India Japan Lighting Pvt. Ltd. (India), and Koito Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. (Malaysia) manufacture and sell automotive lighting. Ta-Yi Transportation Industrial Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has a voting rights ownership ratio of 33%, which is 50% or less, but it is treated as a subsidiary because the company effectively controls it. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥162.6 billion, up 4.6% from the previous year, due to new orders centered on India and higher sales of the company's ordered vehicle models.
entries.fb89bff0329946ee: These are production and sales in the United States, Mexico and Brazil. North American Lighting, Inc. (Illinois, United States), North American Lighting Mexico, S.A. de C.V. (Mexico), and NAL do Brasil Indústria e Comércio de Componentes de Iluminação Ltda. (Brazil) manufacture and sell automotive lighting. North American Lighting, Inc. is a specified subsidiary whose revenue exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue. Cepton Technologies, Inc., a U.S. company responsible for developing LiDAR-related technology, also falls into this segment. From the current period, the company has combined the former 'North America' and 'Other' into 'Americas'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥328.6 billion, up 4.3% from the previous year, due to stronger demand for hybrid vehicles and higher sales of the company's ordered vehicle models linked to customer sales promotion campaigns.
